Definition: feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (G5610 being implied):--evening(-tide).
BiblicalUsage: The plain sense of hespéra is evening. It comes up 3 times, and the passages from Luke and Acts show how steadily Scripture uses it. I do not find a second, secret meaning hiding behind it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hespéra matters because evening is when the day is gathered in, and God comes to walk with His people. I read this as a reminder that God’s words mean what they say, and I can trust them.
RelatedEvents: The Road to Emmaus; Peter and John Before the Sanhedrin; Paul in Rome
